rubric.supported: Claim supported by exact reviewed code and isolated evidence, without an identified material error; no full downstream integration certification
rubric.partial: Real concern, but material qualification, inaccurate example, unsupported additional claim, or incomplete identification
rubric.unsupported: Concrete premise contradicted by reviewed code/control flow
rubric.uncertain: Behavior exists but introduced-defect status or required contract is not established
